documents.title: Supporting evidence
documents.text:
I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds, and I started in October 2023. I knock on the door before entering. I explain what I will do before personal care. I always close the curtains. I respect each person's culture and religion. I ask what the person wants to eat, how they want to be treated, and whether they prefer to be helped by a woman.

One night, I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and immediately told the nurse on duty. The nurse made the safeguarding report. In the dementia unit, residents became agitated late in the day, so the whole team moved dinner earlier.

I have moving and handling training and use the hoist. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for eighteen residents. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is stated there. At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.

We always work in pairs. I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they wanted to eat. I did two years of night shifts, and in the last year I moved to working days.

documents.title: Cover letter
documents.text:
Dear North Yorkshire Council hiring team,

I am applying for the Care and Support Worker role at North Yorkshire Council.

I have worked for three years in a care home in Leeds. I started in October 2023. Before the shift, I read each resident's care plan and do what is stated there. I have medication training and do the morning medication round for eighteen residents. I have moving and handling training and use the hoist. We always work in pairs. At the end of the shift, I write the daily notes in English and sign the medication sheet.

In the dementia unit, residents became agitated late in the day, so our whole team moved dinner earlier. I made cards with photographs of food so each person could point to what they wanted to eat. I did two years of night shifts, and in the last year I moved to working days.

One night, I saw a bruise on a resident's arm. I recorded it and immediately told the nurse on duty. The nurse made the safeguarding report.

Thank you for considering my application.

Yours sincerely, Ana
